verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Two encoding choices, both routine. (i) The third slot is `beta`, which GlobalSlowProfiles.lean:216 documents as the normalized reconstruction `V = X β`, so Lean asserts V_n/X = V_n^in/X rather than V_n = V_n^in; the two are the same statement after multiplying by X, and both sides are the same normalization on each side of the equation. (ii) Lean's region is 0 ≤ X < inner (half-open) where the paper writes the closed [0, X_-]; `inner` plays X_-'s role (Localization.inner_patch gives inner < s.a^2/2, i.e. the inner region ends before the moment patch, exactly as the paper places X_- < X_keep < X_cut < a^2 ≤ inf I_pos), and the endpoint is recovered by continuity, or simply by choosing X_- < inner. The component lemmas it calls (profiles_x_inner_phi/axial/beta) are in fact proved on the closed w.1 ≤ inner; only the pressure component is proved on the strict inequality.
